title: Token outcome
description: One row of the `token_outcomes` table: how a token ended on one horizon, from one reference point, under one rule version. Labels and thresholds: docs/outcomes.md. Source: backend/migrations/0001_init.sql, backend/kairos/outcomes.py.

token_id.description: `tokens.id`. The primary key is (token_id, horizon, rule_version, reference).

horizon.description: Length of the evaluated window as a PostgreSQL interval string. 1 hour is `01:00:00`, 24 hours is printed `1 day`, 7 days is `7 days`.

rule_version.description: Labelling rules version. `v1` is kept for comparison; `v2` adds the `fast_dump` and `pump_and_dump` rug reasons.

reference.description: Where the window starts. `creation`: token creation (what happens to this creator's tokens). `first_mention`: first CA mention by a shiller (was it worth looking at when the shill happened). Scoring uses `first_mention` for shillers and `creation` for creators.

label.description: Checked in this order, first match wins: `no_data` (no price data on the horizon, final only after it ends), `pending` (horizon not finished or trades not yet loaded to its end), `rug`, `success`, `dead`, `neutral`.

peak_multiple.description: Peak market cap on the horizon divided by the market cap at the reference point.

end_multiple.description: Market cap at the end of the horizon divided by the reference market cap.

liquidity_alive.description: At the end of the horizon the curve or pool still holds at least 50% of its peak liquidity and at least 5 SOL.

migrated.description: The token left the bonding curve for a pool before the end of the horizon.

metrics.description: Evidence behind the label. Keys depend on the label and rule version; the ones below are the common ones, extra keys are allowed.

ref_ts.description: Timestamp of the price point used as reference.

ref_lookahead.description: True if the reference price had to be taken from after the reference time (within 2 minutes).

end_cap.description: Market cap at the end of the horizon, SOL.

end_staleness_s.description: Seconds between the last data point and the end of the horizon.

min_after_peak.description: Lowest market cap after the peak, SOL.

liquidity_unknown.description: No liquidity data; liquidity rules are skipped.

despiked_points.description: Single-point price spikes (bad prints) removed before labelling.

coverage.description: How much of the horizon has trade data.

truncated.description: The trade backfill hit its credit cap.

creator.description: Creator sell evidence for the rug rule 'creator sold more than 50% in the first hour' (the hour starts at the reference point).

base.description: Tokens the creator is known to have held.

share.description: sold_in_window / base; null if the base is unknown (the rule then does not fire).

liquidity_crash.description: Evidence of a liquidity drop of more than 80% within 10 minutes (from_*, to_*, drop, seconds); null if none was found.

fast_dump.description: v2 only. Evidence of a market-cap drop of more than 90% within 30 minutes (from_cap, to_cap, drop, seconds, timestamps); null if none.

pump_and_dump.description: v2 only. Evidence of a peak of at least 3x followed within 30 minutes by giving back at least 90% of the gain; null if none.

rug_reasons.description: Why the token was labelled `rug`. Present only for rugs.
